title: MemShift: Separating Detection from Repair in LLM-Derived Personal Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.02338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI assistants store values that a language model derived from a person's records under the person's own definitions, such as their important contacts. Keeping such a value correct takes two steps: detection, noticing that an input changed, and repair, producing the correct new value. Benchmarks that score only the final answer cannot tell which step failed, and they state every change as new text. Seeing this limitation, we present MemShift, a benchmark of five shifts: source revision, deletion, redefinition, writer switch, and export. The first three fork a synthetic world into branches that differ only in the shift. Gold values and dependencies are fixed before any text, and a deterministic scorer replaces an LLM judge. For a memory that reports its invalidations, MemShift shows for each changed item whether the memory noticed the change and whether its repair was right. translated_title: MemShift：在LLM衍生的个人记忆中分离检测与修复
translated_abstract: AI助手会按照个人自身的定义，存储由语言模型从其记录中推导出的值，例如其重要联系人。保持这类值的正确性需要两个步骤：检测，即注意到输入发生了变化；以及修复，即生成正确的新值。仅对最终答案打分的基准测试无法分辨哪一步失败了，并且它们将每次变化都表述为新文本。鉴于这一局限性，我们提出了MemShift，一个包含五种转变的基准测试：源修订、删除、重定义、书写者切换和导出。前三种转变将一个合成世界分叉为仅在转变上有所不同的分支。黄金值和依赖关系在任何文本生成之前就已固定，并用确定性评分器取代了LLM裁判。对于会报告其失效条目的记忆系统，MemShift能够对每个变化的项目显示该记忆是否注意到了变化以及其修复是否正确。此外，我们还构建了一个具有已知检测和修复行为的参考记忆系统（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了MemShift基准测试，通过五种转变类型、分叉式合成世界和确定性评分器，将LLM衍生个人记忆的“检测”（发现输入变化）与“修复”（生成正确新值）两个环节分离评估，从而精确定位记忆维护失败的具体步骤。
en_tdlr: MemShift is a benchmark that separates detection from repair in LLM-derived personal memory, using five shift types, branched synthetic worlds, and a deterministic scorer to pinpoint exactly which step fails when memory systems must keep derived values correct.
